name: PR51 frozen scoring variant: held-out EEGMMIDB subjects 11-20
scope: Prospective held-out participant comparison for the PR51 scoring variant, using real resting EEG plus known injected P3/blinks. Same-source generalization only; not real ERP-task, clinical, or independently executed validation.

evaluation.record_unit: one source participant; conditions and candidates are not independent records
evaluation.primary: record-mean squared gain-corrected population-target selected error
additional: selection regret within feasible fitted family
retention, positive trial weights and unflagged effective support
evaluation.whole_procedure: The main Standard search is freshly fitted per recording with Presets.searchOptions unchanged, including ICA reseeds and adaptive cutoff/EOG checks. Crossfit is not called independent evaluation.
evaluation.calibration_agreement_scope: Pilot diagnostic only. A ratio interval entirely in this band is preliminary agreement; an interval wholly outside is adverse; overlap is not-established. Ten records never establish stable calibration.
evaluation.scientific_decision: See decision_gates. All planned subjects stay in coverage. Incomplete pairs cannot establish improvement; no post-outcome tuning.
evaluation.interval_rule: Record bootstrap order statistic ceil((B+1)*q), clipped to [1,B]; retain all draws, including zero-denominator/undefined calibration mass.

non_goals: No production edits, merge, or release
No outcome-driven thresholds, participants, seeds, excerpts, or per-person variant selection
No alpha/channel-fault or historical detector reruns
No independent clean-neural or clinical ground-truth claim
No PR50 confirmation opening claim; this freezes new-to-PR51 development participants, not an independently conducted external study
variant_change: Pooled within-flag-group residual variance in eyeBias only; unchanged factorial smoothing, BiasZ=2, legacy weight/count semantics, and Standard search.

decision_gates.individual_regression_rule: delta <= max(absolute allowance, relative allowance * baseline MSE)
decision_gates.rule: Incomplete or invalid pair: incomplete. Otherwise worse mean corrected or raw MSE: reject. Otherwise all improvement, individual and support gates pass: retain-heldout-supported. Otherwise inconclusive; do not promote. No automatic production change or merge.
